correctness.rationale: The cap localization matrix is diagonal at the unperturbed cap; its eigenvalue gaps are positive binomial tail partial sums. Second-order perturbation of its simple top eigenvalue produces a negative boundary-integral diagonal term and positive couplings from Fourier modes j<=N, yielding explicit d_{N,j} and a plateau d=1 for j>N. Binomial consecutive ratios imply d_1=0<d_2<...<d_N<1 and the sharp minimum d_2=(2−p)/(2+(N−2)p). The N to infinity p=s/N limit uses binomial-to-Poisson convergence and dominated Fourier sums, not a uniform nonlinear remainder. Independent exact rational arithmetic across 45 (N,p) pairs, N=2..16 and p∈{1/4,1/2,3/4}, verified ordering, null mode and d_2 identity; source eigenmatrix checker inspected, not treated as proof.
